subject: How to write counts in stacked bars

messages.author: fdaa54d30ab7b913
messages.subject: How to write counts in stacked bars
parts:
Dear list members,

I am using geom_bar with position "stack".

How can I include the counts for each section of the stacked bars?

a = c("h","h","h","i","i","i","j","j","j","j")
b = c("n","l","n","l","n","l","z","l","z","z")
data = data.frame(a,b)

d = ggplot(data, aes(a, fill=b))
d + geom_bar(position="stack") +
  coord_flip()


Best,

Manuel

messages.author: 4f04313c0a6b0f2f
messages.subject: Re: How to write counts in stacked bars
parts:
Chang's cookbook, as Doug recommends, is a great resource to keep. In case you don't have access to it, this could get you there. 

library(ggplot2)
library(plyr)

# data = data.frame(a,b)
#  d = ggplot(data, aes(a, fill=b))
#  d + geom_bar(position="stack") +
#    coord_flip()

bartabledf=as.data.frame(table(a,b))
bartabledf=arrange(bartabledf,a,b)
bartabledf=ddply(bartabledf, "a", transform, label_y=cumsum(Freq)-.1*Freq) # You can mess around with the positioning of the labels in the label_y calculation

ggplot(bartabledf[bartabledf$Freq!=0,], aes(x=a, y=Freq, fill=b)) + geom_bar(stat="identity") +
  geom_text(aes(y=label_y, label=Freq), vjust=1.5, colour="white")+coord_flip()

Best,
Vivek

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: How to write counts in stacked bars
parts:
HI Manuel:

Doug is right about the reference (and it's a good one, BTW), but if
you don't have it, here's one way to produce what you want with
centered labels. Winston's way is a little easier - I tried doing this
without the book.

library(plyr)
library(ggplot2)

datos = data.frame(a,b)

# Get the counts
v <- count(datos, vars = c("a", "b"))

# ypos will be the y plotting position of the labels
# in the stacked bar chart, which is why the cumulation
# is necessary
v2 <- ddply(v, "a", mutate, cfrq = cumsum(freq),
ypos = cumsum(cfrq/2))

ggplot(v2, aes(x = a, y = freq, fill = b)) +
geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
geom_text(aes(y = ypos, label = freq)) +
coord_flip()

Dennis
